title: Match the actual raw statistic, reference and calibration allowance
statement: The final square plan uses raw Z^2 with reference V_delta+sigma^2; a debiased score uses a different reference. A coarse-PSD variant retains an unknown-variance upper in the population gap and declines when that sufficient gap is negative. The consumer charges score/reference interval widths and the combined calibration budget, and issues no qualified physical decision without the supplied record/access contract.

requires: Known K2 or K3 endpoint one-quartic mechanical diffusion, bath/metric/temperature and other-quartic absence
Actual finite exposure/read spacing, initialization/energy, electronics PSD or variance contract, calibrated gain/reference/clock and record aggregates
Qualified directed arithmetic and source-specific blur/retention/statistical bounds; no K2/K3 geometry substitution
provides: An explicit finite-record admission rule preserving failed sufficient plans
assumptions: Population moment ambiguity is not equality of finite-record laws
Gain applied before additive electronics differs from gain on the whole raw read
The displayed calibration sensitivity is not an acquired joint uncertainty rectangle
costs: K2 coarse-PSD square: 937983404 raw reads and 4.6118031e11 native model duration, conditional score calibration below 2.7557e-5
K2 calibrated passive duration 3.6831925e11 versus same-bath U1 mean 3.5647510e11; U33 mean 2.884301125e8 pays peak 33, range 32 and recoverable reference loading 528
Directed moment/active inputs and all budget/compiler runs, plus actual acquisition, settling, controls and calibration remain paid
contract.units: Native mechanical stiffness, temperature, variance and quartic coefficient units from the supplied Gibbs model; no automatic SI-time or device calibration conversion.
contract.obstruction: A statistic/reference convention mismatch or unacquired calibration can create a false decision.

body: This is one hidden quartic against zero, not all-quartic tomography or unknown K. Each plan has its own fixed statistical guarantee, not a joint adaptive selection certificate. A K3 coarse-gap failure is not a full-distribution impossibility. Same-bath ordinary driven mean beats the calibrated passive duration; stronger drive pays peak, displacement and recoverable loading energy, which is not irreversible work. Native model time is not lab seconds. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed substantive independent whole mathematical/code/statistical-plan review, with 15 frozen source and four review hashes matched at preservation. This is accepted conditional science, not a physical record, a new audit or a practical passive advantage.
